scope: Fresh official policy reading of relevant representation, deceptive-practices, inventory, interference and privacy requirements; not a completed per-route compliance verdict. Full copyrighted response remains scratch only.

interpretation.representation: Publisher/purpose/content representations and affiliations must be accurate. Educational wording errors are not automatically evidence of deliberate deception or a specific policy violation.
interpretation.inventory: Google-served ads cannot monetize absent/low-value publisher content, navigation-only screens or replicated content without added value. Repeated internal layout or a noindex directive alone does not determine compliance.
interpretation.interference: If ads serve, their placement must not interfere with content, navigation or exit. No actual ads were enabled, clicked or configured by this audit.
interpretation.privacy: Disclosures and applicable consent remain necessary; source disclosure text is not proof of regional runtime compliance.
interpretation.other: Search spam policies are incorporated by the publisher policies; general people-first editorial suggestions are not each a separate mandatory AdSense requirement.

currentSourceObservation.manualEligibilityHelper: src/lib/adInventory.ts has a default-deny manual-placement eligibility helper, referenced by its verification script only. It does not govern Google Auto Ads or prove runtime placement exclusions.
currentSourceObservation.globalTag: index.html loads the Google publisher tag independently of the optional analytics choice; Google CMP/settings and actual ad delivery require separate observation. No protected ad/consent behavior changed.
currentSourceObservation.publicAccountIdentifier: Existing public publisher identity retained; authorized ads.txt entry is source-checked by current CI, not new ownership/account-eligibility proof.

remaining: Read actual AdSense Sites state and precise review/rejection reason if available through authorized account access.
Inspect actual served inventory and regional Google CMP behavior without bypassing protection or changing settings.
Finish individual visual/control/source/originality review before a site-side readiness verdict.
